description: The plot illustrates how loss changes over training time for two methods, shown as two line series with a legend (one labeled “SepLLM” and one unlabeled purple series). The x-axis is labeled “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 250,000 seconds with regularly spaced tick labels every 50,000 seconds. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick labels at 0.05 intervals. The purple series is a solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts near the top of the axis around 2.75 at early training times, decreases steeply at first, then more gradually, reaching about 2.50 by roughly 250,000 s. The red “SepLLM” series is a solid line with circular markers; it begins around 2.71 near the left side, declines smoothly over time, and is just under 2.50 near the right side (around 240,000–250,000 s), with values around 2.50 near approximately 200,000 s. A green dashed horizontal reference line is drawn at loss = 2.50, and green dashed vertical guides bracket a region near the right side of the plot with a green annotation “1.26×” above it.
